projects.desktop.01.title: TECHNICAL VISUALIZATION
projects.desktop.01.description: Technical complexity doesn’t need to feel complicated. Clear visual structure helps reveal how things work and how they connect.
projects.desktop.02.title: SCIENTIFIC ILLUSTRATION
projects.desktop.02.description: Scientific accuracy is only part of the picture. Good illustration also helps reveal what matters, what connects, and what might otherwise go unnoticed.
projects.desktop.03.title: EDUCATIONAL MEDIA
projects.desktop.03.description: Good information is easier to learn when it has a clear visual hierarchy. The right structure can turn dense content into something easier to follow and remember.
projects.desktop.04.title: ANIMATION & VIDEO
projects.desktop.04.description: Some ideas need time, movement and sequence to fully make sense. Motion can reveal change, scale and process in ways a single frame cannot.

hero.story.0.title: Background
hero.story.0.copy: Understanding how things work changes how you represent them. A scientific background brings a different perspective to visual work.
hero.story.1.title: Experience
hero.story.1.copy: From marine ecosystems to industrial environments, every subject brings new challenges and a different way of seeing things.
hero.story.2.title: Approach
hero.story.2.copy: The right questions often matter more than the first good idea. Understanding the details shapes everything that follows.
